title: 第二章  替弟入赘？
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

听到顾延年的命令，四五名如狼似虎的家丁瞬间涌上前来。

顾淮眼神一凝，挥动手中生锈的柴刀拼死反抗。

但他这具常年劳作又大病初愈的身体实在太过虚弱。

一个壮硕的家丁寻着破绽，狠狠一脚踹在顾淮的手腕上。

柴刀应声落地。

两名家丁顺势扑上，将顾淮死死按在那散发着霉味的肮脏泥地上，反剪了双臂，将他押了起来。

顾延年大步上前，没有丝毫犹豫，抬手便是一记沉重的耳光。

顾淮被打得偏过头去，嘴角瞬间溢出一抹猩红，只觉耳畔一阵嗡鸣。

“畜生，谁给你的胆子对你弟弟动刀？”

顾延年居高临下地俯视着他，眼神冰冷得没有一丝温度。

另一边，躲在门边的顾钧还在不停地弓着身子干呕。

他一边吐着酸水，一边指着顾淮恶毒地告状。

“爹，娘......杀了他......呕......”

“我好心好意来叫这废物起床，他竟敢拿那肮脏的夜壶砸我，还扬言要砍死我。”

严氏闻着那股刺鼻的尿骚味，嫌恶地用锦帕捂住口鼻。

“来人，快带二少爷下去洗漱更衣。”

她转过头，死死盯着地上的顾淮，眼中满是歹毒的怨恨。

“老爷，这野种竟敢如此折辱钧儿，今日必须叫人砍了他的双手，让他生不如死。”

然而，顾延年却微微皱眉，抬手拦住了严氏。

“老爷，他如此对待钧儿……”

顾延年却再次打断了严氏。

“夫人，你忘了我们找他来做什么的么？”

他皱着眉头看向顾淮，脸上闪过一丝冷意，但最后还是忍了下去。

“赵家虽然已经没落，但好歹是国公府第，我们找他来代替钧儿，已经不占理儿了，要是再废了他的双手……”

“万一这事真闹到陛下那里，我们都不好交代。”

严氏听闻此言，虽气得胸口起伏，但也只能恨恨地作罢。

顾延年忍受着柴房里的恶臭，嫌恶地瞥了顾淮一眼。

“把他拉下去，好好洗刷干净，换身像样的衣服，带到正堂见我。”

说罢，他甩动衣袖，转身大步离去。

几名家丁如同拖拽死狗一般，将顾淮粗暴地拉到了后院的深井旁。

“嘶啦”一声。

顾淮身上破败的粗布衣裳被家丁毫不留情地一把撕碎。

深秋的晨风透骨生寒。

Page (1/3)

After hearing Gu Yannian's order, four or five servants who looked like wolves and tigers rushed forward instantly.

Gu Huai's eyes narrowed and he waved the rusty hatchet in his hand to resist desperately.

But his body, which had been working for many years and recovering from a serious illness, was too weak.

A strong servant looked for a flaw and kicked Gu Huai hard on the wrist.

The hatchet fell to the ground with a sound.

Two servants pounced on him, pinned Gu Huai down on the dirty muddy ground that exuded a musty smell, cut his arms behind his back, and held him up.

Gu Yannian strode forward without any hesitation, raised his hand and gave him a heavy slap.

Gu Huai was hit so hard that he turned his head away, a flash of scarlet suddenly appeared from the corner of his mouth, and he felt a buzzing in his ears.

"Beast, who gave you the courage to attack your brother?"

Gu Yannian looked down at him condescendingly, his eyes so cold that there was no warmth at all.

On the other side, Gu Jun, who was hiding by the door, was still hunching over and retching.

While spitting out acidic water, he pointed at Gu Huai and complained viciously.

"Father, mother... kill him... ugh..."

"I came here with good intentions to wake this loser up, but he dared to hit me with that dirty chamber pot and threatened to hack me to death."

Smelling the pungent smell of urine, Yan covered her mouth and nose with a brocade handkerchief in disgust.

"Come here, take the second young master down quickly to wash up and change clothes."

She turned her head and stared at Gu Huai on the ground, her eyes full of vicious resentment.

"Master, this bastard dares to humiliate Jun'er like this. Today, we must have his hands cut off and make his life worse than death."

However, Gu Yannian frowned slightly and raised his hand to stop Yan.

"Master, he treats Jun'er like this..."

Gu Yannian interrupted Yan again.

"Madam, have you forgotten why we came to him?"

He frowned and looked at Gu Huai, a hint of coldness flashed across his face, but he endured it in the end.

"Although the Zhao family has declined, it is still the palace of the Duke. It is no longer reasonable for us to find him to replace Jun'er. If we destroy his hands again..."

"If this matter really comes to His Majesty, we won't be able to explain it."

When Mrs. Yan heard this, her chest heaved with anger, but she could only give up bitterly.

Gu Yannian endured the stench in the woodshed and glanced at Gu Huai with disgust.

"Pull him down, wash him well, change into decent clothes, and bring him to the main hall to see me."

After that, he swung his sleeves, turned around and strode away.

Like dragging a dead dog, several servants roughly pulled Gu Huai to the deep well in the backyard.

"His" sound.

Gu Huai's tattered coarse clothes were torn to pieces mercilessly by his servants.

The late autumn morning breeze is chilly to the bones.
